passages.heading: USER APPROVAL — MOV:100–122 SEMANTIC CANONIZATION
passages.text:
USER APPROVAL — MOV:100–122 SEMANTIC CANONIZATION
The user explicitly approved the final adversarial recommendations for MOV:100–122. The packet passed detailed semantic review and final challenge. These nine meanings are canonical; their deterministic generated fields are unchanged; the original 36 source-canonical roots remain unchanged.
Architecture clarification: for every process address 1x2, lexical trit 2 denotes a nonactualized family-domain process that is not presently active or completed and whose realization is dormant, potential, or unresolved. It does not by itself encode event specification, intention, planning, scheduling, queuing, permission, readiness, probability, future time, certainty, or guaranteed occurrence. Runtime [2]/num remains the separate current-status marker for a token of the selected root.
MOV:100 — completed source departure — Completion of a mover’s displacement away from a source position.
MOV:101 — active source departure — Ongoing displacement of a mover away from a source position.
MOV:102 — potential source departure — A potential displacement away from a source position that is not presently active or completed.
MOV:110 — completed target arrival — Completion of a mover’s displacement to a target position.
MOV:111 — active target approach — Ongoing displacement of a mover toward a target position.
MOV:112 — potential target approach — A potential displacement toward a target position that is not presently active or completed.
MOV:120 — completed shared-frame movement — Completion of a mover’s change of position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
MOV:121 — active shared-frame movement — Ongoing change of a mover’s position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame.
MOV:122 — potential shared-frame movement — A potential change of a mover’s position relative to a shared or environmental reference frame that is not presently active or completed.
Route traversal is not atomic in this block. It remains reserved for later composition using shared-frame movement plus MOV:020 established route. Scheduling, queuing, intention, permission, readiness, and probability remain outside these roots. Future semantic changes require an explicit versioned migration.
Current semantic authority: 45 canonical roots and 279 provisional roots. The broad Gate 3 promotion remains withdrawn; this is a separate selective approval.

MAT:200–222 was then reviewed from first principles, independently validated, and approved under the same delegation.
The broad Gate 3 promotion remains WITHDRAWN BEFORE DOWNSTREAM IMPLEMENTATION BY USER DIRECTION. These are selective, versioned approvals only. None of the 36 source-canonical meanings changed, and no deterministic family, address, universal slot, harmonic signature, onset, compact root, formal carrier, or relative note path changed.
